normal: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite source for CORNSILK, a female oatmeal beige plush floppy rabbit, preserving the ATTACHED APPROVED FIRST CANONICAL exactly. She is a realistic physical terry-plush stuffed rabbit, not a human doll. Keep same small stitched black eyes, triangular stitched nose/thread smile, modest round head, VERY LONG asymmetric ears with white inner fabric (one raised bent ear, one hanging sideways), soft narrow torso, long soft arms ending mitten paws, long soft legs and large oval plush feet, subtle seams, textured oatmeal fur. Same head, body, ear and limb sizes in all cells; bent/seated poses must be shorter, never enlarged to fill cells. Body can softly sag, limbs and ears flop naturally with motion. No hair, no vinyl human face, no clothing, no accessories except requested action props. Face and move RIGHT in near-profile/three-quarter view, look ahead RIGHT especially while riding, not straight at camera. CLEAN TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with NO beige/white blurred halo, NO vignette, NO lighting haze, no backdrop, ground, cast shadows, text, grid lines or labels. Soft even toy product lighting on the plush only. Full ears, paws, feet and props entirely inside each cell with ample transparent margins/gutters. Twelve figures never touch one another. ONE portrait 3:4 canvas, exactly THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS of equal square pose cells. Row1: three grounded idles (arms relaxed slightly bent, gentle weight shift, loose paws near belly). Row2: three DISTINCT running strides facing RIGHT: long rightward stride with arms swinging; passing phase with lifted knee; OPPOSITE stride with other leg forward. Ears trail loosely. Row3: shallow jump crouch; airborne with bent knees and paws opened; shallow landing crouch. Row4: seated RIDER side/three-quarter profile facing RIGHT, torso leaning slightly forward, legs bent with feet down/front and both paws reaching for invisible reins, NO mount drawn; braced forward two-paw PUSH to RIGHT, both paws ahead of chest; tumble falling backward LEFT with feet sticking forward RIGHT, surprised loose paws lifted. Preserve original first canonical's upright plush body proportions; no humanoid fingers or fists. Plenty of margin around tall ears even in top row. Essential layout: make each rabbit SMALL within her cell, occupying at most 70% of each cell width and 75% height, centered with at least 12% transparent padding on every side. Ear tips must never approach the canvas edge. Retain the full long ears. IMPORTANT: all figures scaled down to fit comfortably. Leave a continuous clear empty 8% border around the ENTIRE atlas, including above the top row's ears and right of the running feet. Preserve twelve poses and all ear tips; never crop. Exactly 3 columns x4 rows.
